attested.notes: Tone pass against 17-audience-and-persona.md, after the operator flagged the register as too intense ('That clock starts on its own. It may already be running.' read like a film trailer). The persona doc is explicit and I had been breaking it: sound calm, be non-judgmental, never imply the director did something wrong before the facts are known, and avoid fear-led language for anything beyond crisis-stage content. This page serves readers comparing options, not only readers mid-crisis, so action-led is correct and fear-led is not. Roughly fifteen passages rewritten. Removed the dramatic isolated fragments ('That clock starts on its own. It may already be running.'), the ominous verbs ('which deadlines bite', 'it gets grim within days', 'Nobody is obliged to warn you first'), the lecturing constructions ('Directors who plan against the ceiling are the ones who end up signing...'), and the portentous closer ('Everything above follows from that.'). Softened 'demand' to 'require' on the Official Receiver's statement of affairs, and split the three-consequence s131 sentence. A tone-focused stranger read (a seventh question added, asking whether it reads as a calm practitioner or as pressuring) then gave the sharpest diagnosis of the session: a calm practitioner states the SIZE of a risk, not just its existence, and the page named three routes to personal liability while quantifying none, leaving the gap where the reader's imagination works at midnight. Acted on all of it. The conduct-matter line now says what it actually leads to, including that most conduct reports lead to nothing further and that it is a pattern of failures or clear misconduct that draws action rather than one late form. Wrongful trading now says the liquidator must show the point was passed and that the directors did nothing, so claims of this kind are not routine. The lead now states that a few deadlines can be extended if you ask before they expire, instead of raising the exception and abandoning it. 'Resolution date' is glossed where first used rather than 400 words later. '75% majority' is now '75% of the votes cast', which the reader correctly said was ambiguous and mattered to them. Cut 'honestly' from 'nobody can tell you honestly how much time you have', which implied other advisers would lie. Cut the 'in the cases we handle it is the notice that slips' caseload claim: three independent readers have now objected to that shape, and I had defended it twice. The fear-then-service construction ('which is why it is usually the first thing we establish') is replaced by the useful answer, namely how the date is actually reconstructed afterwards from the management accounts, the cash position, and what the board knew. you density now 19.4/1k, inside the voice engine's 15-20 target band for the first time in this page's history, having been 29/1k two passes ago. Body-level we/our/us 4.7/1k with gate check 04 passing; not padded. Rhythm cv 0.403. Scenes and bite counted down honestly to 4 and 3 after cutting the performance lines. Protected sentence intact. No facts, headings or links changed.
